text:
Nelly Korda represents Bradenton, Florida at AIG Women's Open on Sunday, Aug. 2
By
A. P. RossOne golfer from Bradenton, Florida competed at the AIG Women's Open on the LPGA Tour, which wrapped up Sunday, Aug. 2.
Nelly Korda was the top local finisher, placing fourth at 282, 2 under par.
Korda carded rounds of 73 in the first and third rounds and 68 in the second and final rounds.
Shiho Kuwaki claimed the title at 279, 5 under par. Esther Henseleit finished second at 279, 4 under par, and Yealimi Noh took third at 280, 4 under par.
